public.text: Human oversight is stated as a principle, but the draft does not translate it into minimum operational controls for production clinical AI.
public.suggestedRevision: Add minimum controls for clinical AI: named clinical accountability, model and workflow versioning, continuous quality monitoring, drift surveillance, auditable overrides, incident reporting, escalation thresholds and a safe fallback when AI or connectivity is unavailable.
